findings.title: load('sotus') returns a broken sklearn Pipeline instead of the documented SOTU speeches (Drive-id duplicated with nips_model)
findings.repro:
python -c "import hypertools as hyp; s = hyp.load('sotus'); print(type(s))"  # after clearing ~/hypertools_data/sotus if needed
md5 ~/hypertools_data/sotus ~/hypertools_data/nips_model
findings.expected: A list/array of 29-ish SOTU speech texts (1989-2018) per the load() docstring
findings.actual: load('sotus') type: <class 'sklearn.pipeline.Pipeline'>; MD5 (sotus) = MD5 (nips_model) = 6a350ab8d85db34e7b924ac8a7f2a19b

findings.title: import hypertools permanently silences numpy divide/invalid warnings process-wide
findings.repro: env MPLBACKEND=Agg python -c "import numpy as np; b=np.geterr(); import hypertools; a=np.geterr(); print(b); print(a); print(np.array([1.0])/np.array([0.0]))"
findings.expected: np.geterr() unchanged by importing a library; divide-by-zero in user code still warns
findings.actual: before: {'divide': 'warn', 'over': 'warn', 'under': 'ignore', 'invalid': 'warn'} / after: {'divide': 'ignore', 'over': 'warn', 'under': 'ignore', 'invalid': 'ignore'}; 1/0 produced [inf] with NO warning raised

findings.title: analyze(x, align=False) crashes although its docstring documents False as 'no alignment'
findings.repro: env MPLBACKEND=Agg python -c "import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp; hyp.analyze(np.random.rand(25,6), align=False, ndims=3)"
findings.expected: No alignment applied; reduced data returned (per docstring)
findings.actual: ValueError: unknown model: False

findings.title: hypertools/core/config.ini is not packaged: wheels ship 90 .py files only, and get_default_options() silently returns empty defaults
findings.repro:
cd /tmp && python -m pip wheel --no-deps --no-build-isolation -w wheelout /Users/jmanning/hypertools && unzip -l wheelout/hypertools-*.whl | grep -c '\.ini'
python -c "import hypertools.core.configurator as cfg; print(dict(cfg.get_default_options('/nonexistent/config.ini')['plot']))"
findings.expected: config.ini included in wheel; get_default_options() returns the shipped [plot]/[reduce]/[align]/[cluster] defaults on installed copies
findings.actual: wheel: 95 files, no config.ini; missing-ini [plot]: {} / [cluster]: {} -- silently empty, no exception

findings.title: Hosted *_model example datasets are sklearn-1.0.2 pickles: repr()/display crashes under the required sklearn>=1.4
findings.repro: env MPLBACKEND=Agg python -c "import hypertools as hyp; m = hyp.load('nips_model'); print(m.transform(['neural networks'])); print(repr(m))"
findings.expected: Loaded model usable and displayable
findings.actual: InconsistentVersionWarning: Trying to unpickle estimator CountVectorizer from version 1.0.2 when using version 1.8.0 ...; transform -> (1, 50); repr(nips_model) FAILED: AttributeError 'Pipeline' object has no attribute 'transform_input'

findings.title: Full Procrustes math implemented twice in align/procrustes.py, already diverging
findings.repro: python -W always -c "import numpy as np; from hypertools.align.procrustes import procrustes; procrustes(np.random.rand(10,3), np.random.rand(10,3), format_data=False)"
findings.expected: One shared implementation; no deprecation warnings on normal use
findings.actual: PendingDeprecationWarning: the matrix subclass is not the recommended way to represent matrices ... (raised twice per call); duplicate code blocks confirmed by diff (301-line unified diff of two ~150-line twins)

findings.title: hyp.align(single array) returns a 1-element list, violating its own documented return contract; internal comment about manip's return type is wrong
findings.repro: env MPLBACKEND=Agg python -c "import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp; x=np.random.rand(25,6); print(type(hyp.align(x)), type(hyp.reduce(x, ndims=3)), type(hyp.manip(x)))"
findings.expected: align(single) -> single ndarray per docstring; comment matches manip's actual return type
findings.actual: hyp.align(single array) -> <class 'list'> len 1; hyp.reduce -> ndarray; hyp.manip -> DataFrame
